SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.DOCNUM + '-' + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) DOCKEY ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,T1.OPTDES OPTDES1 ,T2.OPTDES OPTDES2 ,S.FAC ,S.ITMVER ,( S.QTY - Isnull(P.PORQTY, 0) ) QTY--采购单位数量 ,( S.QTYSTU - Isnull(P.PORQTYSTU, 0) ) QTYSTU--库存单位数量 ,S.STU--库存单位 ,S.UOM--采购单位 ,S.UOMCOE--采购单位系数 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.REQDAT, 21) REQDAT--要求到货日期 --,S.NETPRI--未税单价 ,CAST(S.GROPRI/(1+0{7}) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) NETPRI--未税单价 ,S.GROPRI--含税单价 ,S.CUR --,S.TAXRT--税率 ,0{7} TAXRT--税率 ,S.DOCTYP SRCTYP--来源类型 ,S.DOCNUM SRCDOC--来源单据 ,S.DOCLIN SRCLIN--来源行号 ,S.DOCSTA--单据状态 ,H.RESNO--申请人 ,R.RESNAM RESNODES ,S.IVATTYP ,S.REMARK LREMARK ,CASE WHEN S.CUR = '{6}' THEN '1' ELSE '' END CHOOSEFLG --20250820SHIDA FROM PINQUL S LEFT JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO --产品 LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T1 ON ITM.TSICOD1 = T1.OPTID AND T1.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD1' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T2 ON ITM.TSICOD2 = T2.OPTID AND T2.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD2' LEFT JOIN PINQUH H ON H.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM --询价完成 LEFT JOIN [ENTRES] R ON H.[RESNO] = R.RESNO --申请人 LEFT JOIN (SELECT L.SRCDOC ,L.SRCLIN ,Sum(L.QTY) PORQTY ,Sum(L.QTYSTU) PORQTYSTU FROM PORDLIN L INNER JOIN PORDER R ON L.DOCNUM = R.DOCNUM WHERE ( Isnull(R.CLOREA, '') + Isnull(L.CLOREA, '') = '' OR L.DOCSTA = 6 ) --排除手动关闭的记录 --SHIDA20250524 OR L.DOCSTA = 6 AND L.SRCTYP = 'PIN' GROUP BY L.SRCDOC ,L.SRCLIN)P ON P.SRCDOC = S.DOCNUM AND P.SRCLIN = S.DOCLIN WHERE S.DOCSTA = '2 ' AND S.QTY - Isnull(P.PORQTY, 0) > 0 AND H.SITE = '{0}' AND S.BPSNO = '{1}' AND S.ITMNO LIKE N'%{2}%' AND S.ITMVER LIKE N'%{3}%' AND ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMSPEC + ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE N'%{4}%' AND S.DOCNUM LIKE N'%{5}%' ORDER BY REQDAT DESC
